name: senzing-bootcamp-maintainer
description: Maintainer tooling for the Senzing Bootcamp Kiro Power. Use when creating the Senzing bootcamp power from a template release, when updating it to a newer template release, when checking it for parity with the parent release, when escalating a curriculum problem to the parent, when auditing it for production readiness before the manual checklist, when releasing a tested version with its changelog entry and git tag, when propagating it into a working tree of the public Senzing/senzing-bootcamp-kiro-power repository for review, or when retrofitting edits made in that public repository back as triaged issues.
